simple.summary: בָּרֹד (bârôd) means spotted (as if with hail) First listed occurrence: Gen 31 10.

definitions.full: H1261. barod [ בָּרֹד ] adjective spotted, marked (as if sprinkled with hail ? so Ki compare Lag BN 29 ; Syriac , i.e. grandinatus, grêlé , PS), masculine plural of sheep & goats וּבְרֻדִּים נְקֻדִּים עֲקֻדִּים Gen 31:10 , 12 ; horses Zech 6:3 , 6 .
